title: bare definite integral
source: STAGE0.md first pass, S1; WHAT.md, Start here
statement: Evaluate the definite integral of 3x² + 2x from 0 to 1.
notes: The control case: no divisor, no partial builtin and a literal range, so installation owes nothing and ftc owes only its three regularity premises.
F(1) - F(0) is 1^3 + 1^2 - (0^3 + 0^2), which ring evaluates, so no named entry is used.
